column1: # Purpose: Account for every AST and symbol class in the audited compiler.
# Responsibilities: Identify preserved payloads, missing relationships, and classes without a live producer.
# This file intentionally does NOT infer behavioral coverage from a class-name switch.

column3: preserved
column4: remaining

column3: Kind and ordinary node fields.
column4: No additional semantic union payload; source/generated ownership belongs to the source graph.

column3: Result expression child and resolved type.
column4: LOAD.isres is absent.

column3: Assignment opcode, children, and resolved types.
column4: Initialized assignment options and source adaptation/access roles are absent.

column3: Raw/concept operator, children, and initialized branch target.
column4: Operator options, complete source operator coverage, evaluation/control/effect roles are incomplete.

column3: Raw/concept operator and child.
column4: Initialized options and source operation/adaptation roles are incomplete.

column3: Conversion, float narrowing, and const conversion flags.
column4: Pre-conversion source identity and conversion reason/lineage are absent.

column3: Opcode, child, and source concept when observed.
column4: Complete source event and escape roles are absent; unused ex must remain unread.

column3: Raw/concept operation, stable branch kind, and target.
column4: Inversion options, source exit ownership, and complete control-flow edge roles are absent.

column3: Ordered unsigned value/label pairs, default, bias, and span.
column4: Source SELECT/CASE ownership and normalized CFG edges are absent.

column3: Call kind/count, ordinary children, formals, result temporary, and virtual static target.
column4: Deferred copyback/profiling trees, source argument/default/adaptation roles, late actions, and execution order are incomplete.

column3: Constructor call and instance children plus resolved object type.
column4: Source constructor/materialization/lifetime identity and reason are incomplete.

column3: Stable stack operation and ordinary child.
column4: Final stack placement is backend detail; explicit access/effect roles are derived.

column3: Operation kind, byte count, fill value, and children.
column4: Explicit read/write/effect roles and complete source operation identity are absent.

column3: Wrapper children and attached label identity.
column4: Source/generated loop ownership and execution/control-flow roles are absent.

column3: Vocabulary only.
column4: AST header explicitly states no COMP nodes exist; comparisons use other node classes. Do not manufacture fixture nodes.

column3: Ordinary children and result-edge selection.
column4: Semantic sequence/evaluation/conditional roles need explicit representation.

column3: Exact typed value.
column4: Written suffix/spelling/escape/contextual typing intent and source/generated ownership are absent.

column3: Symbol, type, and byte offset.
column4: Source use identity, access role, and definition/use relationships are absent.

column3: Children, symbol/type, byte offset, and index scale.
column4: Complete source index/call distinction, evaluation order, and storage access roles are absent.

column3: Attached field/type and ordinary children if still live at export.
column4: Earlier bitfield lowering can erase the source field node; source/lowering/access correspondence is absent.

column3: Resolved type, child, and byte offset.
column4: Source dereference identity, uncertainty, and access/escape roles are absent.

column3: Symbol and label-scope relation when initialized.
column4: Declared/statement/GOSUB metadata and explicit CFG roles are absent; flush is an emission detail.

column3: Attached formal, expression, mode override, and aggregate bytes.
column4: Source ordinal/supplied/default/hidden roles, conversion/materialization lineage, and ABI/evaluation details are incomplete.

column3: Symbol and byte offset.
column4: Source/generated address identity, emitted link identity, and escape roles are incomplete.

column3: Attached symbol and live children.
column4: Full declarator/statement identity, initialization ownership, and declaration order are absent.

column3: Unindexed array child and resolved type.
column4: Source use/call adaptation and descriptor/access roles are incomplete; runtime shape is intentionally unknown.

column3: Children and false target.
column4: Source operand graph, conditional evaluation, lifetime ownership, and CFG roles are absent.

column3: Compiler literal/comment text.
column4: Source graph ownership is not explicit; debug/comment emission is not source execution semantics.

column3: Kind; some BASIC operands have separate B records.
column4: Ordered ASTASMTOK text/symbol payload, operand linkage, source extent, and conservative barrier/clobber policy are absent.

column3: Vocabulary; lowered descriptor initializers and exact stored values exist elsewhere.
column4: Transient nodes are consumed before export; source DATA items/ordering and label ownership are absent.

column3: Kind; subsequent nodes inherit logical lines only when debug nodes were created.
column4: Semantic source mapping is debug-dependent; detailed debug operation/ex/file payload belongs to an optional emission artifact.

column3: Index expression, temporary, and checking runtime call children.
column4: Late handler transfers and source/effect/CFG ownership are incomplete.

column3: Pointer expression, temporary, and checking runtime call children.
column4: Late handler transfers and source/effect/CFG ownership are incomplete.

column3: Scope symbol, ordinary node fields, and scope metadata.
column4: Source block identity and initialized parent/entry/exit/statement relationships are incomplete.

column3: Scope symbol and ordinary node fields.
column4: Matching source scope/end ownership and cleanup/control roles are incomplete; do not read begin-only union fields.

column3: Vocabulary and any surviving ordinary child data; some cleanup I ranges.
column4: Break-list payload is consumed before ordinary export; source exit parent/scope/statement/target/action identity is absent.

column3: Offset/byte count, live children, and initializer-owner H relation.
column4: Semantic initializer scopes, source graph/lineage, and ownership are incomplete.

column3: Offset and byte count.
column4: Source/generated padding/initializer ownership is incomplete.

column3: Offset/byte count, assigned field, and value child.
column4: Source initialization/access/adaptation roles and scope ownership are incomplete.

column3: Offset/byte count and constructor call child.
column4: Source constructor/action/lifetime owner and scope lineage are incomplete.

column3: Offset, element count, and constructor child.
column4: Source array/action/lifetime order and scope lineage are incomplete; bytes is an inactive union alternative.

column3: Array-initializer flag.
column4: Initialized offsets/bytes, matching scope identity, and source/owner relationships are absent.

column3: Kind.
column4: Initialized offsets/bytes, matching scope identity, and owner relationships are absent; is_array is not assumed initialized.

column3: P signature/body location and ordinary body roots; procedure wrapper is not traversed.
column4: Main/entry/exit/block/statement payload needs explicit records, not a fabricated N wrapper.

column3: Stable VA_START/END/COPY/ARG operation, ordinary children, and resolved types.
column4: Source varargs operation, ABI policy, adaptation and access/effect roles are incomplete; this is not a preprocessor macro node.

column3: Unicode index kind, operands, and resolved scalar type.
column4: Indexed-read runtime CALL is created during astLoad, after export; source operation/access/effect correspondence is incomplete.

column3: Name/type/size/storage/visibility/owner/status, arrays/descriptors, live initializers, string literals, and alignment.
column4: Implicit source origin, declarator/order/lifetime/linkage/snapshot metadata are incomplete; generated literal names can contain bytes the supplied reader cannot decode.

column3: Name/type/owner and exact value.
column4: Written literal intent, complete declaration/source expression identity, and normalized type/flag contract are incomplete.

column3: Signature, formals/defaults, result subtype/method, override/slot/overloads, and exported bodies.
column4: Special declaration anchors/origin, full ABI, linkage/priority/status/registration, source call graph and snapshot ownership are incomplete.

column3: Type, source passing mode, optional/rank/default, ordinal/THIS role, and live body variable.
column4: Prototype spelling/names and real descriptor/register ABI classification are incomplete.

column3: Definition parameters/replacement tokens/text/flags/callback kind and retired definition snapshots.
column4: Invocation/substitution/callback-result/source provenance and definition lifetime events are absent; accepted legacy token bytes can break the supplied reader.

column3: Name/class/type/owner/status metadata.
column4: Token ID/class and source reservation/keyword policy are absent.

column3: Name/owner plus initialized label-scope relation.
column4: Declared/statement/GOSUB flags, full source definition/use roles, and control-flow identity are incomplete.

column3: Name, lexical owner, lookup namespace, declaration/use bindings, and import relationships.
column4: Reopening/include/context instances and ordered import visibility are incomplete.

column3: Type/owner/member constants and element count.
column4: Source enum/member scope extents, declaration order, normalized nominal type/flag policy are incomplete.

column3: Type/union/base, padded/unpadded size, selected alignment, options, abstract count, return dtype, fields and special-member relations.
column4: Separate natural/pack/effective alignment, retin2regs, vtable/RTTI ownership, source initializer/lifetime graph are incomplete.

column3: Vocabulary and lookup cases.
column4: No class-symbol constructor found in this source inventory; do not infer a working class payload or manufacture source coverage from the name.

column3: Resolved type/owner/offset/size/bit position/width/array/alignment and retained initializer.
column4: Complete source declarator, initialization/lowering identity, declaration order, and access/lifetime roles are incomplete.

column3: Alias declaration identity/name and resolved underlying dtype/subtype; ordinary alias-use bindings.
column4: Complete source type-constructor/alias graph, qualifiers/promotion policy, and forward-name use closure are incomplete.

column3: Generated forward identity and canonical resolved-symbol relationship.
column4: First unresolved type-name source use is absent in the probe; private backpatch lists should not be exported as source references.

column3: Lexical owner, logical line extent, and begin/end body nodes.
column4: Physical source scope/occurrence identity and complete control/lifetime ownership are incomplete; frame base offset is emission detail.

column3: Name/class/owner/status metadata for actual reserve symbols.
column4: Source reservation event and effective keyword/assembly policy are absent; do not read VAR payload merely because reserve symbols share a lookup path.

column3: Imported namespace and lexical/lookup owner metadata.
column4: Source USING occurrence, order/lifetime/context and visibility event graph are absent; linked-list pointers are implementation state.
